scope: Same localized sheet, ordinary unsigned coordinate squares after signed propagation. Only failed rail tests resolve position. Release means the end of preparation. Terminal flight tubes require a separate calculation; no observations are used.
conventions: lambda=1/2; nearest even positive m; deadlines in two-tick blocks. Original launches include timeouts. Fair count and a new localized sheet on each failed attempt are separate controls. The small physical oracle keeps unreduced integer amplitudes, divided in probability by four per block. Finite sector probabilities and the renewal arithmetic use binary64.
